hazards.evidence: Standard-height tub wall must be stepped over; the white shower chair sits entirely inside the tub (all legs in the basin) rather than straddling the edge as a transfer bench, so a walker user after hip/knee replacement still has to lift a leg over the ~15-inch tub apron to get in.
Smooth acrylic tub/shower floor with no visible non-slip mat or adhesive treads; surface becomes slippery when wet.
Large dog lying in the bathtub in a small bathroom; pet occupying the tub and likely to move around the walker user's feet in a confined space.
